data_description.municipality: Type to search the municipality you want to track.
data_description.name: The name used for the sensors in Home Assistant.
data_description.ecocenter: Adds a sensor telling whether the municipality's EcoCentro is open, with its opening hours (also shown on the card).
data_description.calendar: Adds a calendar entity with one event per pickup day, shown in the Home Assistant calendar.
data_description.more_options: Residual bin emptyings, sidebar page and reminder defaults, on the next pages. They can also be set later from Configure.

confirm_duplicate.title: Municipality already configured
confirm_duplicate.description:
{municipality} is already configured as {names}. Do you want to add another calendar for the same municipality, named "{location}"?

Submit to add it, or close this window to cancel.

emptyings.title: Residual bin emptyings
emptyings.description: Count the emptyings of the residual waste bin against the yearly allowance.

data_description.household_members: Leave empty to skip emptyings counting. The yearly allowance is members + 1 emptyings of 120 L.
data_description.bin_liters: Standard is 120 L; with a different bin the allowance is rescaled proportionally (e.g. 60 L = twice as many emptyings).

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.description: A Contarina page in the Home Assistant sidebar, with the month's pickups, the EcoCentri map and the waste search of all the calendars.

data.sidebar_pickups: Show tomorrow's pickups in the sidebar

data_description.panel: Shown if at least one calendar turns it on.
data_description.sidebar_pickups: The sidebar entry shows what is collected tomorrow, e.g. "Contarina · Organic, Paper", with the waste's icon. Also turns the page on.

reminders.title: Pickup reminders
reminders.description: How the reminder popup opens (tap a waste type on the card or the sidebar page). Also used by the contarina.add_reminder action without a time or a device.

data_description.reminder_days: 0 = on the pickup day itself: then the time can be at the latest 6:00.
data_description.reminder_notify: "Last used" remembers the last choice made in the popup on each browser.

error.location_in_use: A calendar with this name already exists. Enter a different name in "Rename municipality".
error.unknown_municipality: Municipality not found: pick one from the list.
error.reminder_time_too_late: With 0 days before the pickup the reminder time must be at the latest 6:00.

add_emptying.name: Mark emptying
add_emptying.description: Marks an emptying of the residual waste bin.

remove_emptying.name: Remove emptying
remove_emptying.description: Removes a marked emptying of the residual waste bin.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day of the emptying to remove.

search_waste.name: Where does it go?
search_waste.description: Searches the Contarina waste dictionary (downloaded once a day) and returns the containers for each matching item, with the English names when the language isn't Italian.

query.name: Item
query.description: Word to look for in the item names, e.g. "capsule" or "battery".

limit.name: Maximum results
limit.description: How many items to return at most (default 10).

language.name: Language
language.description: "it" for the Italian names, anything else for the English ones (default: the Home Assistant language).

add_reminder.name: Add pickup reminder
add_reminder.description: Sends a notification at the chosen time before a pickup of this waste type.

at.name: When
at.description: When to send the notification: at the latest 6:00 on the pickup day. Default: the reminder settings of the integration (e.g. 20:00 the day before).

date.name: Pickup day
date.description: Pickup the reminder is for (default: the next one).

notify.name: Notify service
notify.description: E.g. mobile_app_my_phone (without "notify."). Empty: Home Assistant notifications. Left out: the device chosen in the integration settings.

remove_reminder.name: Remove pickup reminder
remove_reminder.description: Removes the reminder of a pickup of this waste type.

not_emptyings_sensor.message: Emptyings can only be marked on a "Residual emptyings" sensor.

search_failed.message: The Contarina waste dictionary could not be reached. Try again later.

not_waste_sensor.message: Reminders can only be set on a waste type sensor (e.g. Organic).

no_pickup.message: There is no upcoming pickup of this waste type.

not_a_pickup.message: There is no pickup of this waste type on {date}.

reminder_too_late.message: The reminder must be at the latest at {hour} on the pickup day.

reminder_in_past.message: The reminder time has already passed.

reminder_tomorrow.message: Tomorrow: {waste} pickup. Remember to put the bin out tonight.
